title: Plan SELECT query families, semantic contracts and crossover experiments
acceptance_criteria: Premeasurement protocol records predictions, equivalent answer groups, SQL contracts and falsifiers with revision/tag provenance.

validation: Containerized checks appropriate to task; every test has a report

Queue audit, HIGH review, main ancestry and annotated-tag verification
review_policy: HIGH reviews Decision Log, acceptance and evidence; label self-review if no independent reviewer
